description: Diagrama de Carga de Subestação (Lisboa e Portalegre) is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset presents the load diagram of electrical grid substations, with hourly records and geographic location (district, municipality, and parish). The information allows for the analysis and comparison of load between different substations. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Electrical Network, Consumption and Energy. Its keywords are internal. The portal shows 2025-11-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
